newsitem.title: UK: Scotia appoints new medical director.
newsitem.headline: Scotia appoints new medical director.

text.p: British biotechnology group Scotia Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it had appointed Dr Robert Dow, 47, as Medical and Development Director.
Dow will be responsible for Scotia's clinical drug development and regulatory affairs world-wide, and will be based in Stirling, Scotland.
He joins the group from Roche in Switzerland, where he is currently worldwide director of Drug Development.
It is anticipated that Dow will be elected to the board.
A medical graduate of St Andrews and Dundee Universities, Dow had an academic career in pharmacology, cardiology and endocrinology before joining Syntex Research in Scotland and then Roche in 1994.
